sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: Players within 70 units take the scripted poison burst every fifteen seconds.
Be ready to heal the random player selected for Toxic Secretion every thirty-two seconds.
At 25%, the scripted timers stop and Severilous becomes more vulnerable to archery and backstab.

notes: Reviewed quest source; behavior, balance, spawns and completion have not been verified in a live instance.
This document applies to instance version 200.
Only the version-200 custom mechanics are documented. The standard open-zone spawn does not run these combat timers.
Health-phase comments say slashing, but the implemented skill IDs 7 and 8 are archery and backstab. Guidance follows the implementation.
